description: lockstep manifest for socket-registry. Each `file-fork` row named `npm-port-*` records one `test/npm/<pkg>.test.mts` conformance suite that is a 1:1 port of an upstream package's own test file, tied to that upstream's `upstream/<owner>-<repo>` reference pin. The row is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for the port's provenance; the prose `@file` header in the ported suite is checked against it by `scripts/repo/check/npm-port-provenance-is-current.mts`. Wiring the remaining overrides is documented in docs/agents.md/repo/npm-port-provenance.md.

deviations: swap tape's `test(name, t => …)` harness for vitest `describe`/`it`
load the @socketregistry/is-nan override through setupNpmPackageTest instead of requiring the upstream entry point
drop upstream's shim/shimmed suites — the override ships no shim surface
rows.notes: es-shims tags are ANNOTATED, so forked_at_sha is the tag object of v1.3.2, not its peeled commit. Both identify the release and both resolve for `git log`/codeload; the check compares the recorded SHA to the .gitmodules ref, never to a peeled commit.

deviations: swap tape's `test(name, t => …)` harness for vitest `describe`/`it`
load the @socketregistry/has-tostringtag override through setupNpmPackageTest instead of requiring the upstream entry point
rows.notes: forked_at_sha here is the peeled commit of v1.0.2 — the corpus records both conventions, which is why the manifest, not the prose header, is the pin of record.

deviations: swap tape's `test(name, t => …)` harness for vitest `describe`/`it`
swap `t.plan`/`t.equal` assertions for collected results plus `expect(…).toEqual`
load the @socketregistry/for-each override through setupNpmPackageTest instead of requiring the upstream entry point
add TypeScript annotations on the collected-result arrays the upstream JS leaves untyped
swap tape's `test(name, t => …)` harness for vitest `describe`/`it`
load the @socketregistry/is-data-view override through setupNpmPackageTest instead of requiring the upstream entry point
inline the es-value-fixtures / make-generator-function / make-arrow-function / object-inspect helper inputs as literal values (the fixture workspace does not carry those helpers)
reference the typed-array constructors directly instead of via global lookup, and drop the typeof DataView guard (Node >= 24 always ships DataView)
rows.notes: v1.0.2 is an annotated tag; forked_at_sha records its peeled commit (ccf89aec is the tag object). The check compares the recorded SHA to the .gitmodules ref.
